propositions: Completion verification fails without verdict due to request-budget exhaustion, runaway duplicate tool-call loops, or token exhaustion, leaving no scored or signed result.
Per-criterion recovery fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion (22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 requests worst case), creating wasteful re-sends of ~2.67M context characters.
Flat 100,000-char recovery context bound refuses ticket contexts that grow beyond threshold (live c9f7 rejected at 121,147 chars), making certain tickets unverifiable.

Completion verification must record per-criterion verdicts incrementally to a run-scoped bank and finalize to full-coverage verdict whenever any progress is banked, ensuring verdict-less failures are eliminated.
Duplicate read-only tool calls repeat across agentic runs instead of being memoized, causing redundant execution (observed 144× repetition of identical search_files calls).
Completion verifier performs redundant file reads that could be pre-loaded from ranked file_impact contents, with live traces showing 67-82% of distinct file reads are coverable by pre-loading.
